title: Displaying the Power of the Jedi
description: When Luke Skywalker trained on the swamp world of Dagobah, he had to battle many of the misconceptions he held about the world around him. One of those was about the size and scale of his ability in the Force and the universe around him. His master, Yoda, challenged him, and informed him that, "Size matters not." Grogu learns a similar lesson in his meditation session with Luke. Trying to find a snack of a single frog through the Force, he failed to sense the others nearby, until Luke showed him that power as he looks on in awe.
